name: ThirdShotHub Kitchen Pro 14 Tunable
description: The ThirdShotHub Kitchen Pro 14 Tunable is our house-brand control paddle for players who like to experiment with swing weight. Four magnetic tungsten weight ports along the edge guard let you add or remove 2-gram weights in seconds, so you can shift the balance toward the head for more drive power or toward the handle for faster hands at the kitchen line. A 14 mm polypropylene honeycomb core and textured carbon fiber face keep it crisp and spin-friendly, and the core carries a lifetime warranty against delamination.

specifications.weight: 7.8 oz base (up to 8.3 oz with all weights installed)
specifications.weight_ports: 4 magnetic ports, includes 8 x 2 g tungsten weights

care_instructions: Wipe the face with a damp microfiber cloth after play and let it dry before covering. Keep the magnetic weights in the included case when not installed, and never leave the paddle in a hot car.
